author: Matic0B
body:
Part 1: About You
What is your age? 18
What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.) Matic0B#4502
How active can you be in order to contribute to the team? Fairly active after this week, daily activity on Discord, less in game.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder? Huge amount of experience over the years with good understanding of the gamemodes. Having some of the best rated maps 

Part 2: Skills
What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay? Most important thing when it comes to gameplay is understanding the players, how much knowledge and experience they have and understanding the gamemode you are planning the map for. You need to know the audience and take their opinion into consideration as they are the ones that will use the "product"
How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors? Don't have much experience but can learn it.
As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both? Moslty building maps but when needed, I could work on XML.

Part 3: Past Experience
Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums. I've only made Clay Wars which back then didn't have a thread but was submitted directly to a Map Developer.
Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain. Former Map Developer / Level Designer on Overcast with a lot of maps made some of which topped their gamemode lists with ranking.

 - Main author of SolitudeMC, highest rated DTC on Overcast;
 - Main author of Safehouse, highest rated CTF on Overcast;

Part 4: Self Reflection
Why do you want to be a builder? I'm slowly coming back into map making and would like to start working with an active team to create high quality maps.
How do you think you will help the map development team? I can bring a lot of experience and I understand the gameplay. There are various things I've learned over the years that I'd be able to share.
